substitutions.from: search `~/.cursor/plugins/` for a file whose path ends in `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md`. If more than one file matches, use the copy whose `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` has the highest `version`. Your skill catalog hides this skill, so a missing catalog entry does not mean pstack is absent. If no such file exists, stop and tell your parent.
substitutions.to: load the `poteto-mode` skill with the `skill` tool. The pstack plugin registers every pstack skill under its folder name. Your skill catalog hides this skill, so a missing catalog entry does not mean pstack is absent. If the `skill` tool cannot load it, stop and tell your parent.
